Name: Biotanix Labs
Description:
Turning surgical waste into therapeutic systems

Biotanix Labs is developing a platform that repurposes clinically established hydrogel technology into implantable therapeutic systems.

During surgery, biologically active material (such as bone fragments and fluids) is routinely discarded. Biotanix Labs captures and combines this autologous material with its hydrogel delivery matrix (HDM) to create biologically active grafts and localized drug delivery systems — effectively converting surgical waste into a therapeutic asset.

The underlying material has over 20 years of clinical use in hemostasis, providing an established safety foundation while enabling new applications across:

• orthobiologics (e.g. spinal fusion)
• implantable drug delivery systems
• infection control and biofilm management

This approach sits at the intersection of cost reduction, improved clinical outcomes, and localized therapeutics, without requiring significant changes to existing surgical workflows.

Biotanix Labs is currently progressing toward pre-clinical validation and advancing its intellectual property strategy.

We are interested in connecting with clinicians, researchers, investors, and strategic partners working in medical devices, drug delivery, and orthopedics.

AROA is unlocking regenerative healing for everybody. AROA’s products make a meaningful impact for patients, surgeons and clinicians. Name: In Vitro Technologies

In Vitro Technologies is a leading distributor of scientific, clinical diagnostic, medical, and industrial solutions across Australia and New Zealand.

We represent globally trusted brands and deliver high-quality instruments, consumables and specialist services to researchers, clinicians and industry professionals.

ADInstruments is committed to providing innovative tools for research and education. Our company helps scientists and educators achieve their goals with our industry-leading PowerLab and LabChart data acquisition systems.

#MakingScienceEasier

Name: Marama Labs
Description:
MaramaLabs’ CloudSpec instrument has a valuable capability for UV-Vis analysis – it can measure through cloudy liquids.  If you think of all the liquids you encounter daily you will begin to appreciate how much of a stumbling block this is for UV-Vis. CloudSpec’s novel ability – scatter-corrected absorption (SCA) spectroscopy – enables quantitative analysis of the constituents of cloudy liquids quickly and easily.
CloudSpec is a perfect fit for nanomedicine development, manufacturing and quality control.  Nanomedicines are too small to see but they protect and deliver new classes of drugs – vaccines, oncological treatments, gene therapies and more – safely and effectively into the body.  With CloudSpec, drug developers can quantify potency in seconds, accurately and easily, for substantial time and cost savings.

Exxovantage is a fully integrated workplace solutions provider, combining exoskeletons and exosuits, workplace wearables, data analytics and AI fit-for-purpose solutions and risk management tools.

Enabling the Life Science Sector
CBE represents Australia’s leading consultants across the biopharmaceutical sector, providing strategic solutions and increased efficiency.

Name: Ruminant Biotech
Description:
Welcome to Ruminant Biotech. 

We were founded out of a desire to solve the global methane emissions problem caused by ruminant animals. With methane emissions from livestock being one of the largest unaddressed sources of greenhouse gas emissions, and a major focus for governments and corporates worldwide, we have developed a slow-release device, called a bolus, that sits in the cow’s rumen for up to six months and delivers high levels of methane knockdown over that time period.

We're changing the game in greenhouse gas emissions from ruminant animals.

Name: Keraplast
Description:
Keraplast is a world-leading biotechnology company that recovers bioactive keratin proteins from regeneratively farmed New Zealand wool.  We are a global exporter, and we are proud partners of Croda International, AIDP Inc and IFF Health.

Keratin is one of nature’s most important building blocks at a cellular level.  It gives the human body structure and order, and is fundamental in the development of healthy tissues including skin, hair and nails.

Using our proprietary Functional Keratin platform technology, we recover soluble keratin proteins from wool fibres while controlling the protein molecular weight and cysteine availability.  We then blend these proteins together to create ingredients that are 91% homologous to human keratin.  Our unique, bioactive ingredients are used in the world’s leading beauty and personal care products.    

Our mission is to create life-changing ingredients for life-changing products.

We are on our journey to becoming a regenerative business and we have committed to ensuring that all of our wool is traceable back to individual farms and sustainable wool growers.  We have introduced a four-day working week throughout our organisation, all of our staff are salaried, and we are actively working towards gaining B-Corp Certification.

Description: Sapro-Tech combines science and design to disrupt the conventional textile industry. With our exclusive technology, Sapro-Tech is producing innovative, long-lasting, and visually appealing biopolymer-based textiles. These sustainable alternatives will revolutionise the fashion industry and extend their application to various other sectors

Name: Greenfern Industries
Description:
Greenfern Industries Limited is an entrepreneurial-led licensed medicinal cannabis and biotechnology company that also has operations spanning into the industrial hemp, hemp food & body care space. It's listed on the NZX stock exchange under the GFI ticker.

Greenfern operates primarily from their medicinal cannabis research facility and hemp processing hub in Normanby, South Taranaki, with these facilities powered by renewable energy generated by Greenfern’s own hydroelectric power station located adjacent to the facility on the Waingongoro River.

Greenfern is committed to environmentally friendly production of medicinal cannabis and hemp-based products. The research facility is designed around maximum efficiency and sustainability, being powered by renewable power and using an aeroponic production system renowned for its optimal water and nutrient efficiency. Greenfern’s hemp production follows the same ethos. The hemp seed and its by-products are used for a range of different products from a high protein ingredient in a plant-based meat substitute, a hemp-based skin care range and hemp-based beverages amongst other things.

As well as being B Corp Certified, Greenfern is also Toitū net carbonzero certified & was NZ's first medicinal cannabis company to receive both certifications.

Name: PAQ Laboratories
Description:
The Experiment Company conducts research in honey profiling with the aim of assisting New Zealand beekeepers in increasing their crop’s revenue. We are the first in New Zealand to develop a novel diagnostic test kit to identify the potency characteristics of Kanuka Honey and an authenticity test to identify unique chemical markers present in it. 

Our vision is to make science simple and accessible. 

Our mission is to become the GOLD standard within the global honey industry for AGP and Anti-bacterial analysis for honey producers and packers.

Name: Kimer Med
Description:
Kimer Med is a New Zealand biotech company, developing a pipeline of novel, broad-spectrum antiviral drug candidates. With success against 24 different viruses so far, we’re taking on the global health challenge of viral disease and future pandemic threats.

Our vision is to end the immense suffering caused by viral disease. 

There are currently around 270 viruses that cause disease in humans, and only 13 of them have an approved antiviral treatment available. In other words, 95% of viral diseases lack any approved treatment, resulting in enormous unmet medical needs worldwide.

We have designed and optimised a proprietary platform for the rapid development of broad-spectrum antiviral drug candidates to address these massive medical needs. Our goal is to bring to market a family of broad-spectrum antivirals to treat multiple diseases, and provide pandemic protection.

To date we have achieved efficacy against 24 different viruses spanning 12 virus families, and proved the broad-spectrum capability of our platform. We are currently in the lead-optimisation phase of our R&D.

In 2024, Kimer Med was recognised as one of Fierce Biotech's 'Fierce 15 of 2024' - the best and brightest of biotech. We are also the recipient of a Merck Emerging Biotech Grant, and multiple grants from Callaghan Innovation.

Name: Gillies McIndoe Research Institute

At Gillies McIndoe Research Institute, our mission is to transform lives by developing accessible, life-changing treatments. As an independent biomedical research charity, we tackle some of the most challenging conditions—brain cancer, vascular birthmarks, and keloid scars. Our approach to tackling these conditions includes repurposing existing drugs, allowing us to explore affordable solutions that ease pain and suffering while expanding access to care.

Our internationally recognised team uses advanced techniques like spheroids, organoids, proteomics, and metabolomics to conduct groundbreaking research. By testing treatments in environments that closely mimic human biology, we ensure our discoveries are both precise and impactful. Bridging in vitro methodologies with physiology, clinical trials, and advanced organoid models, we turn scientific breakthroughs into real-world healthcare solutions.

Our work has the potential to spare patients invasive surgeries, harsh treatments, and unaffordable care—bringing hope and healing within reach for all. If you’re seeking a partner with scientific rigor, a collaborative spirit, and a commitment to innovation, we invite you to join us in advancing research that changes lives. Description:
Kode Biotech Limited is a private company established in 1996 to commercialise and license KodeTM Technology. Kode Biotech Ltd is the licensor of existing, and developer of new KodeTM Technology.

Name: Ra Biotech Ltd
Description:
Point of care (POC) diagnostic market is expected to be UD$50.6 billion by 2025 @ CAGR of 11.4%. With COVID pandemic, the demand for more innovative diagnostics solutions is ever increasing. The need is for more rapid and accurate results, whilst minimising the need for complex sample handling. POC diagnostic tests can offer all the benefits including digital integration via cloud network communications.
POC diagnostic tests are dominated by using antibodies as the recognition bio-receptor. Antibodies do work and has for years. But for small molecular targets, antibodies do suffer from specific binding. This is where aptamers can shine. There has been considerable academic research in developing aptamer based biosensors but none been commercialised thus far. The limiting factor we believe is the lack of devoted effort into building biosensors around the unique physiochemical properties of single stranded oligonucleotides. Aptamers deserve to stand on their own and not as an antibody replacement entity.
We at Ra Biotech believe that our knowledge and experience with developing aptamers will lead to the commercialisation of total diagnostics solutions using aptamers as the primary bio-receptor. We have over a decade of R&D experience with aptamers and demonstrable assays that can work in an analytical laboratory setting and portable infield testing capability.
